correctness.rationale: The finite proof is exhaustive and independently reconstructed. Distinct factors are converted to their position-coverage sets; duplicate and inclusion-nonminimal edges can be removed without changing hitting sets. Independent enumeration gives 100/392/1560 distinct factors and 12/18/26 inclusion-minimal coverage edges for t_4/t_5/t_6, with no hitting set of size at most 3 and exactly 87/40/32 hitting sets of size 4. The stored t_6 solutions agree exactly with the explicit product family choosing one position from {16,17}, {32,33}, {48,49} and one from exactly one of {24,25} or {40,41}. Every listed set is rechecked against all factor occurrences.

The three cases are not an arbitrary window: t_4 and t_5 are the exceptional base cases for the known size theorem and t_6 is the first case in its uniform regime.
